name: Tabs
usage: Groups on a detail page (Overview / Related records), categories of a settings page

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs: `key`, `label` and the content in `children`.

props.name: activeKey
props.description:
Key of the selected tab (controlled): the tabs show it, and switching only calls `onChange`, so update it there.
Use it when the selected tab lives elsewhere, such as in the URL. The name pairs with `defaultActiveKey`.

props.name: defaultActiveKey
props.description: Key of the tab selected at first (uncontrolled); the first tab by default.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the key of the newly selected tab.

fields.name: children
fields.description: Content shown while the tab is selected.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Tabs are given in `items`; the indicator line slides between tabs.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled
examples.description:
`activeKey` with `onChange(key)`: the selected tab lives in your state (or in the URL), and can also be changed
from outside the tabs.
